title: Pedestrian deaths as a share of all US traffic deaths, 2022

source.name: Pedestrian Traffic Fatalities by State, 2022 Preliminary Data / Traffic Safety Facts
source.publisher: GHSA / National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA)

notes: GHSA's 2022 pedestrian count (7,508, the most since 1981) set against NHTSA's 2022 total traffic death count (42,514): pedestrians made up about 1 in 6 of all US traffic deaths that year.
